verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a probe that notes a prior (2026-10-06) dossier saw an open robots.txt at aima.gov.pt. The 2026-10-07 probe of https://aima.gov.pt/robots.txt failed TLS certificate verification, so a standard keyless agent could not actually read it before fetching. A robots.txt appears to exist but is currently unreachable for a verifying client, and its contents were never observed in this pack. Missing for 10: a successful current fetch of robots.txt, a valid TLS chain for standard clients, visibility into the actual robots.txt directives, and independent corroboration.
